instruction: Fix loss of custom adapter keyword arguments during redirects. Session.send accepts extra options for a custom transport, but those options disappear on redirected requests. Preserve custom options across every redirect while retaining standard options and existing redirect behavior. Inspect the repository and implement a compatible fix. Only existing Python files under requests/ will be exported. No network is available. You may write local tests; do not modify upstream tests. Submit after focused checks pass.
